saltborn.name: Saltborn Compact
saltborn.answer: Flee by sea; the ocean remembers.
saltborn.desc: Amphibious sailors who keep their memories inside symbiotic jellyfish. They hold the sea lanes of the Coast of the Drowned Bells.

lantern.name: Lantern Conclave
lantern.answer: Record everything; nothing may be forgotten.
lantern.desc: Moth-winged archivists who store memories as light in lanterns, high on the Lampwick Stilts.

rootwardens.name: Rootwardens
rootwardens.answer: Forgetting is natural; the Hush is a season that must pass.
rootwardens.desc: Wooden folk grown from seeds planted on graves. They tend the Ember Wood, a forest in endless autumn.

glass.name: Glass Caravans
glass.answer: Sell what the Hush leaves behind.
glass.desc: Beetle-folk merchants who sail the Sunken Dunes in glass-hulled ships, trading in the ruins of forgotten cities.
